description: Waggle delivery hooks. None of them touches the network: each asks the local waggle service, and an empty run is one file check. Each line runs in sh, Git Bash and PowerShell alike (bin/waggle.cmd: sourced by sh, run as a batch file by PowerShell). Proprietary software, (c) 2026 Waggle: see LICENSE (no reverse engineering, decompiling or derived clones).

hooks.command: set -- hook start; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook start; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook idle; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook idle; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook prompt; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook prompt; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook bash; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook bash; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook edit; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook edit; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook read; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook read; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook tool; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook tool; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook stop; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook stop; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook idle; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook idle; exit $LASTEXITCODE
set -- hook end; . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/waggle.cmd" hook end; exit $LASTEXITCODE
